WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cur_category, cp.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' AS is_ol, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS l0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS l1
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT YEAR(d0) AS y, MONTH(d0) AS m, COUNT(*) AS keys, SUM(c) AS rows_, MIN(d0) AS first_d, MAX(d1) AS last_d, SUM(CASE WHEN d0<>d1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_differs, SUM(CASE WHEN l0<>l1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS load_differs
FROM dup GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

    FROM fact_sales_line f

    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

mine AS (

  WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1
),

by_category AS (

           d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_category ty
JOIN by_category ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
ORDER BY ty.category
